instruction.text: First, read the two paragraphs. Then, listen to the sentences and choose the sentence that combines the information of the two paragraphs best.

b.sound: Forest fires are dangerous for some indigenous peoples.
Wildfires are necessary for forests to grow new trees.
Although wildfires are a huge threat to many indigenous peoples, they can improve wildlife habitats.
Cher and Whitney are powerful women, amazing singers and political activists.
Singing in the church gospel made Whitney Houston extremely successful.
Both, Whitney Houston and Cher are very popular women. They are incredibly talented singers that influenced people around the world.
Zeus was a Greek God who liked to play with lightning.
Jupiter is a planet made out of gas and stone.
Zeus and Jupiter are gods from different cultures, but they share many characteristics.
